title: Add ECE as 4th NSGA-II Pareto Objective
source: MDPI Information 2026: Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting (doi:10.3390/info17010056)
summary: Add Expected Calibration Error (ECE) as a 4th Pareto objective in the NSGA-II GA, alongside the current Brier + ROI + Sharpe tri-objective. The 2026 MDPI paper shows calibration quality (ECE/MCE) is the dominant predictor of ROI in betting markets — better-calibrated models achieve +15-25% higher ROI even at identical Brier scores.

motivation.paper_finding: LSTM+shot_chart+market features: Brier 0.089. But the key finding is that ECE/MCE-calibrated models achieve significantly higher ROI. Our fleet best is Brier 0.22249 but we don't optimize for calibration — we may be leaving ROI on the table.
motivation.current_gap: NBA GA optimizes Brier + ROI + Sharpe. No calibration quality signal in Pareto. A model with Brier=0.224 but ECE=0.10 will dominate a model with Brier=0.222 and ECE=0.01 in our current scheme, even though the latter is far better for Kelly betting.
motivation.fleet_evidence: S13 (catboost specialist) had Brier 0.22086 (fleet best) but ROI 31.54% — suggests well-calibrated catboost. S15 (wide_search) has Brier 0.23 but ROI 13.62% — likely poorly calibrated. ECE objective would separate these.

implementation.how: Compute ECE during fitness evaluation using 10 equal-frequency bins. Add as 4th minimization objective in NSGA-II. ECE = sum_b |confidence_b - accuracy_b| * n_b/N
implementation.code_sketch:
from sklearn.calibration import calibration_curve
def compute_ece(y_true, y_prob, n_bins=10):
    fraction_of_positives, mean_predicted = calibration_curve(y_true, y_prob, n_bins=n_bins, strategy='quantile')
    bin_sizes = np.histogram(y_prob, bins=n_bins)[0]
    ece = np.sum(np.abs(fraction_of_positives - mean_predicted) * bin_sizes) / len(y_prob)
    return ece
implementation.risk: Adding 4th objective increases Pareto front size, may slow convergence. Mitigate by using low weight (ECE×0.5) or as soft constraint

expected_impact.brier: Neutral to slight improvement — calibrated models often generalize better
expected_impact.roi: +5-15% improvement expected based on MDPI paper findings
expected_impact.implementation_effort: LOW — 5-10 lines in fitness function, no architecture change
expected_impact.test_island: S10 (exploitation) — most stable island, good baseline
